# PKCS#12 (.pfx) import fixtures. Password for every store: tlslib
# Generated with OpenSSL 3.2.1 (multikey_pfx merged with JDK keytool). Do not weaken tests to fit these.
# rsa_pfx / ec_pfx: single self-signed leaf + its key, default profile
#   (PBES2 AES-256-CBC bags, SHA-256 integrity MAC).
# rsa_altalg_pfx: the same RSA leaf under a different profile (PBES2 AES-128-CBC bags,
#   SHA-1 MAC) - proves import is algorithm-independent, not pinned to one profile.
# chain_pfx: RSA leaf signed by a test root CA; store holds leaf key + leaf cert + CA cert.
# ca_cert_der: the test root CA certificate (DER), the PKIX anchor for chain_pfx.
# multikey_pfx: two private-key entries (rsa-leaf + ec-leaf); ambiguous for one credential.
# Leaf-selection fixtures (plaintext, no-MAC PFX - password is unused): TlsLib selects the leaf by
# key match, not by store order or the key<->cert link. They reuse chain_pfx's leaf + CA, so
# ca_cert_der stays the anchor. Provenance: extract chain_pfx's leaf, CA and (PKCS#8) key with
# OpenSSL, then reassemble as unencrypted no-MAC PFX SafeBags with the bag order and localKeyId
# below (asn1crypto) - OpenSSL cannot emit these arrangements. All expect chain [leaf, CA] except
# nomatch.
# nolink_cafirst_pfx: no localKeyId anywhere, CA bag first (positional linkage leads with the CA).
# orphanlink_pfx: the key's localKeyId matches no certificate (the linked lookup finds no leaf).
# wronglink_pfx: the key's localKeyId points at the CA certificate, not the leaf.
# nomatch_pfx: the key and the CA only - no certificate pairs the key (import must fail closed).
rsa_
rsa_altalg_
ec_
chain_
ca_cert_
multikey_

nolink_cafirst_
orphanlink_
wronglink_
nomatch_
